Nobody times their rest. Everyone thinks they do. Cutting rest on a heavy set doesn't make it harder - it makes it lighter. You just move less weight and call it intensity. Heavy strength work wants 3-5 minutes. Hypertrophy 90 seconds to 2 minutes. Accessories 60-90. Feeling ready and being recovered aren't the same thing. How long are you actually resting? Be honest 👇

Pulling goes first on upper days, because almost everyone already has more pressing volume than pulling - and whatever you do first gets your best effort.
